title: Implement secure organization invitations
summary: Implemented owner-managed, one-time organization invitations with HMAC-only token storage, encrypted browser handoff, exact verified-provider-email acceptance, atomic membership activation, revoke/resend/expiry lifecycle, HMAC-keyed rate limits, audit events, multi-invite onboarding, accessible screens and synchronous mail previews/fakes.

migrations: 20260904073000 creates new invitations and invitation_rate_limit_buckets tables with lifecycle and normalization checks
and same-organization composite foreign keys; no existing table rewrite
decisions: raw invitation tokens remain only in mail and a two-hour encrypted HttpOnly cookie; OAuth persists only the fixed review path; acceptance requires an active provider-verified matching email; removed memberships are never invitation-reactivated; initial role data is bounded intent until RBAC assignment exists
risks: Initial generic multi-database redo and TEST= system invocations were rejected by Rails command routing

then corrected namespaced/direct commands passed; effective application of initial role intent is deliberately deferred to the role-assignment prompt; synchronous mail delivery may require an owner resend after provider failure
